entries.headline: USAF transports and increased coded traffic reported
entries.summary: War Watch reported six U.S. Air Force transport aircraft airborne over North America and the North Sea, and said coded radio traffic had reached 15 broadcasts that day.

entries.headline: Coded USAF broadcasts and transport flights reported
entries.summary: War Watch reported four coded U.S. Air Force radio broadcasts during the preceding hour, with transport aircraft airborne across the United States, North Sea and Mediterranean.

entries.headline: USAF transports and elevated Taiwan-area activity reported
entries.summary: War Watch reported multiple U.S. Air Force transport aircraft airborne across the Pacific and North America, and said air activity near Taiwan was nearly four times its usual level.

entries.headline: Suspilne Kyiv metro-station damage report highlighted
entries.summary: War Watch highlighted a Suspilne report that a Russian attack on Kyiv damaged a metro station on the left bank, citing Mayor Vitali Klitschko, and said two outlets had confirmed the report.

entries.headline: Putin trilateral-meeting proposal reported
entries.summary: War Watch reported that Vladimir Putin proposed a meeting next month with Donald Trump and Xi Jinping to discuss the war. The item was credited to reagan0965.

entries.headline: USAF transports, coded broadcasts and Gulf activity reported
entries.summary: War Watch reported six U.S. Air Force transport aircraft airborne across multiple regions, three coded radio broadcasts during the preceding hour, and Gulf-region air activity at three times its usual level.

entries.headline: TWZ fighter-drone control report highlighted
entries.summary: War Watch highlighted a TWZ report that an F-22 pilot controlled an FQ-44 fighter drone from the cockpit for the first time. The item was credited to reagan0965.

entries.headline: Insider Paper Canada-base incident report highlighted
entries.summary: War Watch highlighted an Insider Paper report that a serious incident at a Canadian base caused deaths and sparked a fire. The item was credited to reagan0965.
